name: secureshellgo
description: Your servers through the SecureShell Go AI Bridge: list hosts, read stats, services, logs and files by host name, and, only where you allow it and with your approval in the app (or under rules you set beforehand), run commands, write files, restart services and open a terminal. The app keeps the keys.

bridge_token.title: Pairing token
bridge_token.description: From SecureShell Go: Settings → AI Bridge → Connect an assistant. Shown once when you pair.

launcher.title: Launcher command
launcher.description: secureshellgo-mcp for the deb, rpm, Arch package and the Microsoft Store install, secureshellgo.mcp for the snap, the exported command (…/flatpak/exports/bin/com.dhivalabs.secure_shell_go) for the Flatpak, the full path of the .AppImage file for the AppImage, or the full path of secureshellgo-mcp next to the app for the Linux tarball or Windows zip. Connect an assistant in the app shows the right one.
